question: How does drought (SPI-1 ≤ −1.5 in the month of the harvest) change the regrowth of a grassland after a silage harvest, measured as light use efficiency LUE = GPP / PAR, within the same cut number?

overrides.text: Start 8 Sep 2021 from the file text ("harvest started 8 Sep and lasted at least 5 days"); the rows of 10 Sep and 15 Sep (threshing) are one episode.
End 24 Aug 2022 from date_end ("end 23 or 24 Aug").
Cleaning cut on 19 Jun and silage harvest on 20 Jun 2023 are one episode: start = cut day, group silage harvest, the cut is a co-event.
Cleaning cut on 21 Aug and silage harvest on 22 Aug 2023 are one episode: start = cut day, group silage harvest, the cut is a co-event.
First cut on 17 Aug and second cut on 24 Aug 2023 (7 days apart) are one episode.

figureTitles.2: Later cuts: light use efficiency after the harvest, dry and normal month

method.yRangeRule: Figures 1 and 2: one range over their drawn means, CI bands and the single curve (rounded outwards to a multiple of 0.25, extended to hold 0 and 1). spi3Rule.note: dry = SPI-3 <= -1.5 of the harvest month; the second full grouping (groups.spi3, composite.spi3, Figures 4 and 5); no later cut is dry

rules: Sites: Anttila, Sarkisuo, Qvidja and Viikki (order of db/sites.parquet). Day numbers count
the days since 1970-01-01; all windows include both end days. Day 0 = the last day of the
harvest (end).
1. Episodes: the silage harvest episodes of Deep Dive #7 (analysis/silage-harvest-response):
the harvest and cut events of the five Finnish sites are merged (an event that starts not
more than 7 days after the last day of the current episode joins it), the five OVERRIDES
apply, and an episode is used when no other harvest or cut episode and no grazing or
tillage event overlaps the days start-14 to end+14, GPP, TER and NEE have 12 or more days
in the before (start-14 to start-1) and the after (end+1 to end+14) window, and the mean
measured fraction of NEE is 0.10 or more in both windows. The 20 used episodes are the
same as in Deep Dive #7. The two flagged Viikki episodes (establishment year 2023-08-17,
partial harvest 2024-06-14) stay in the episode table and in Figure 3, but they are not
in the group statistics and not in the group curves of Figures 1 and 2.
2. Daily PAR (mol m-2 d-1) per local day (ts_start in UTC + utc_offset_min of the site): the
mean of the 30-min ppfd (umol m-2 s-1) x 0.0864 (= 86 400 s x 1e-6); a day counts when
40 or more of its 48 half hours have a value (the mean fills a gap of up to 8 half hours).
Qvidja has no ppfd: daily SW_in (MJ m-2 d-1) = mean sw_in (W m-2) x 0.0864 with the same
rule, x k (mol MJ-1). k = the median, over the days with PAR >= 5 mol m-2 d-1 at the
sites that have both ppfd and sw_in (Anttila, Viikki, and Sarkisuo because it has 100 or
more such days), of the daily ratio PAR / SW_in. The per-site medians and the 10 to 90 %
range are logged; the per-site minimum and maximum median give the sensitivity of k.
k / 4.57 gives the energy fraction of PAR in the global radiation (4.57 umol J-1 is the
common PAR conversion, stated without a page: an assumption, PAR_CONVERSION_ASSUMPTION),
for the comparison with the 42 % of Heimsch et al. 2024 (LITERATURE).
3. LUE_d = GPP_d / PAR_d (g C mol-1), GPP_d from data/calculated/daily.parquet (g C m-2 d-1).
A day with PAR < 5 mol m-2 d-1 has no LUE (the count is logged). Reference window = the
days start-14 to start-1 with a LUE value: gppBefore and parBefore are the means over
these days, and lueBefore = gppBefore / parBefore (the ratio of the window means over the
same days, so that relGPP_d = relLUE_d x relPAR_d holds on each day; the mean of the daily
LUE is also stored). An episode with fewer than 12 LUE days in the reference window is
excluded ("too-few-par-days"). Relative LUE, GPP and PAR of a day = value / reference.
Window means over the days with a LUE value: after = end+1 to end+14, late = end+15 to
end+28; a window mean is null with fewer than 12 LUE days, and the late window is null
when another harvest or cut episode or a grazing or tillage event overlaps it (the rule
of Deep Dive #7). The product of the window means of relLUE and relPAR is stored next to
the window mean of relGPP (they differ, because a mean of products is not the product of
the means).
4. Dryness: SPI-1 of the station of the site (Vantaa: Viikki; Kaarina Yltoinen: Qvidja;
Kuopio Maaninka: Anttila and Sarkisuo) in the calendar month that holds end. Dry = SPI-1
<= -1.5 (SPI_DRY, a project definition). Also stored: SPI-3 of that month, SPI-1 of the
next month, and the SWC anomaly = mean swc of the local days end to end+14 minus the mean
swc of the same site on the same calendar dates in all its data years (daily swc with the
40 of 48 rule; the number of years is logged). Sensitivity groups: SPI-3 <= -1.5 and SWC
anomaly < 0 (group means only; the main result uses SPI-1), and SPI-1 <= -1 (the rule of
the TypeScript dive nee-without-harvest-drought). The SPI-3 rule (dry = SPI-3 <= -1.5 of
the harvest month) is also a second full grouping (groups.spi3, composite.spi3, Figures 4
and 5) with the same statistics as the main rule where n allows: the bootstrap CI only
with 3 or more episodes, the exact permutation test with 2 or more per group. With the
SPI-3 rule, no later cut is dry (groups.spi3.later.n.dry = 0): there is no SPI-3 figure
of the later cuts.
5. Groups: first cut (cutNo = 1, the ordinal of the episode among the harvest and cut
episodes of the site in that year) and later cuts (cutNo >= 2). A fertilisation in the
days start-14 to end+14 only sets the flag fertInWindow.
6. Statistics per cut group, dryness and window (after, late) for relLUE, relGPP and relPAR:
n, mean, SD, bootstrap 95 % CI of the mean (10 000 resamples, percentile method, numpy
PCG64, fixed seeds, n >= 3), the difference dry - normal with a bootstrap CI (both groups
resampled, n >= 3 each) and an exact permutation test of the difference of means (all
C(n, nDry) splits; two-sided p = the share of splits with |difference| >= the observed
|difference|). With one dry episode (later cuts) there is no test: the single dry value
is given against the mean, SD and range of the normal group, also in SD units.
Composite day-by-day curves of the mean relLUE, relGPP and relPAR per group (days -14 to
+28 from end): the value of an episode is null from the day end + next disturbance on
(the next harvest, cut or grazing of the site); per day the mean, SD, n and the bootstrap
CI (n >= 3); mean and SD are null when n < 2, except in a group of one episode (the dry
later cut), whose curve is the episode itself. The y range of Figures 1 and 2 is one range
over all drawn means, CI bands and the single curve, rounded outwards to a multiple of
0.25 and extended to hold 0 and 1. The y range of Figure 4 is the same rule over the
curves of Figures 1, 2 and 4 together (composite.yRangeSpi3); the result tells whether it
equals the range of Figures 1 and 2 (composite.yRangeShared).
7. Each step that removes rows or changes values logs a count (results.json dataVersion.steps).
8. Open findings of docs/anomaly-data-report.md that touch this dive are printed
(OPEN_FINDINGS).
openFindings: ANT-01, SAR-01, VII-01 (open, waits for the providers): the raw stamps of Anttila, Sarkisuo and Viikki are UTC, but the build reads them as UTC+2. A local day of these sites thus holds the hours 02:00 to 02:00 true local time, and the daily PAR, GPP and swc of these sites hold 2 hours of the previous evening instead of the own evening. The effect on a daily sum is small and on a 14-day window mean smaller.
VII-05 (open): Viikki 2024 nee_f is not equal to nee in 1 540 periods. The GPP of the partitioning around the 2024 harvests can thus differ from the measured values.

june2018.note: Heimsch et al. 2024 classify June 2018 as extremely dry by SPEI (qvidja2018Drought); the SPI-1 of the Kaarina Yltöinen series gives this value for June 2018

literature.text: Photosynthetically active radiation (PAR) was empirically estimated to be 42 % of the global radiation.
SPEI categories: − 1.0 to − 1.49: moderately dry; − 1.5 to − 1.99: severely dry; − 2.0 and below: extremely dry. The dry limit of this dive, SPI-1 <= -1.5, equals the lower bound of "severely dry".
In terms of SPEI, the first growing season of our study (in 2018) could be mostly classified as severely or extremely dry. May, June and July were extremely dry months with SPEI < − 1.99.
The mean daily PAR was about 12 % higher in 2018 than in 2019 (460 vs. 410 µmol m−2 s−1), while the precipitation sum was 32 % lower (212 vs. 312 mm) (May to September).
The clearly lower leaf-area-based photosynthetic capacity (GP1200) in 2018 compared to 2019 probably indicates drought-related stress on photosynthetic processes.

The speed of the regrowth after a cut is a property of the species and the cultivar; the cutting height, the number of cuts and the nutrient supply change it. A large leaf area left in the stubble can speed up the regrowth, especially in dry conditions.

figures.title: Light use efficiency (GPP / PAR) from 14 days before to 28 days after the last day of a first silage cut, as a fraction of the LUE of the 14 days before the harvest: 3 cuts in a dry month (SPI-1 ≤ −1.5) and 7 cuts in a normal month; mean and bootstrap 95 % CI over the episodes.
figures.desc: One panel. X axis: days from the last day of the harvest (−14 to +28, local days, UTC+2). Y axis: LUE = GPP / PAR as a fraction of the LUE of the days −14 to −1 before the first day of the harvest, from −0.50 to 2.00; thin lines mark 1 and 0, an orange vertical line marks day 0 (the last day of the harvest). Markers every 7 days. Lines: normal group steel blue, solid, with circles; dry group vermillion, dashed, with squares. The band around each line is the bootstrap 95 % CI of the mean over the episodes, drawn where 3 or more episodes have a value; the line is drawn where 2 or more have a value. Dry episodes: qvidja-2019-06-11, qvidja-2022-06-21, qvidja-2023-06-19. Normal episodes: anttila-2022-06-21, anttila-2023-06-21, qvidja-2018-06-12, qvidja-2021-06-14, qvidja-2024-06-15, sarkisuo-2022-06-30, viikki-2022-07-01. Days +1 to +14: relative LUE dry 0.64 (95 % CI 0.30 to 0.82, n 3), normal 0.51 (95 % CI 0.41 to 0.59, n 7); difference dry − normal 0.13 (95 % CI −0.19 to 0.36), exact permutation p = 0.31 (120 splits). Days +15 to +28: relative LUE dry 0.97 (95 % CI 0.52 to 1.30, n 3), normal 1.13 (95 % CI 0.82 to 1.39, n 6); difference dry − normal −0.16 (95 % CI −0.63 to 0.31), exact permutation p = 0.62 (84 splits).

figures.title: Light use efficiency (GPP / PAR) from 14 days before to 28 days after the last day of a later silage cut (cut 2 or more), as a fraction of the LUE of the 14 days before the harvest: the normal group (6 cuts, mean and bootstrap 95 % CI) and the one cut in a dry month, Qvidja 2020-08-28 (SPI-1 −2.11).

Markers every 7 days. Lines: normal group steel blue, solid, with circles, with the bootstrap 95 % CI band of the mean (drawn where 3 or more episodes have a value); the dry episode qvidja-2020-08-28 vermillion, dashed, with squares, no band (one episode). Days +15 to +28: relative LUE dry 1.28 (SD n/a, n 1), normal 0.87 (95 % CI 0.75 to 1.00, n 4); the dry episode is 1.28 against the normal mean 0.87 (SD 0.15, range 0.74 to 1.06), 2.6 SD units; no test with one dry episode.

The band around the normal line is the bootstrap 95 % CI of the mean over the episodes, drawn where 3 or more episodes have a value; the dry line has no band (2 episodes, fewer than 3); the line is drawn where 2 or more have a value. seedRule.groups: SEED_BASE + 1000 x cut group + 100 x quantity + 10 x window + dryness (0 dry, 1 normal, 2 difference)
seedRule.composite: COMPOSITE_SEED_BASE + 2000 x cut group + 1000 x dryness + 100 x quantity + day index (0 = day -14); the seeds list gives the first seed of each curve
seedRule.spi3: the SPI-3 grouping uses the same rules with SPI3_SEED_BASE and SPI3_COMPOSITE_SEED_BASE

events.rule: events of the five Finnish sites; harvest and cut events make the episodes

observations.rule: 30-min rows of the four grass sites (Parquet filter on site_id); local day = floor((ts_start + utc_offset_min) / 1 day), ts_start localised to UTC

daily.rule: daily rows of the four grass sites; no row is removed, a missing value is a gap

spi.rule: one row per station and month; no row is removed

dailyPar.rule: daily PAR = mean ppfd x 0.0864 (mol m-2 d-1), daily SW_in = mean sw_in x 0.0864 (MJ m-2 d-1), daily swc = mean swc; a day counts with 40 or more of 48 half hours; LUE = GPP / PAR on the days with PAR >= 5 mol m-2 d-1

episodes.rule: silage harvest episodes; used when no overlap, 12 or more days per window, measured fraction 0.10 or more (Deep Dive #7) and 12 or more LUE days in the reference window; a flagged episode is not in the groups
